# DJKridP

> DJKridP is a multi-genre DJ from Osnabrück, Germany, and a former member of Future Breeze. Active since the late 1990s, he has performed DJ sets internationally across Germany, Canada, South Africa, Japan, Russia, Poland, Spain, Italy and other countries. This is his official website: live sets, releases, playlists, Twitch stream schedule and contact links. The site is bilingual (German/English).

## About

- [Official website](https://djkridp.vercel.app/): DJKridP — multi-genre DJ, former member of Future Breeze, Osnabrück, Germany
